newsitem.title: VIRGIN ISLANDS: Virgin Islands halts most vendor payments.
newsitem.headline: Virgin Islands halts most vendor payments.

text.p: Acting finance commissioner Joanne Bozzuto ordered all agencies and departments to temporarily stop paying vendors until she completes an analysis of the government's cash flow.
Bozzuto said she was examining the books to try and find $27 million for the partial payment of retroactive salaries owed to government workers.

"Until preliminary cash-flow projections are completed this week, no vendor checks other than those representing payment for services rendered and funds properly drawn down under federal programs will be released," she said in a memo.

During a budget hearing in September, former Finance Commissioner Gwendolyn Adams said vendors were owed at least $20 million, but some senators said the figure could be double that because of outstanding invoices held by agency heads.
